name: spec-images

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: 3 images + 4 texts, drafted no cache vs serial
after-text, other-image, text-first, image-first, two-images, concurrent (cache on)
SPEC=dspark PREFIX_CACHE=on VISION=on: 5 prompts + 2 shared prefixes
record drafted vs serial + diff + concurrent
taps_equal, no_drafter, graph_replay, the_drafter_follows, draft_equals, a_snapshot_restores, a_cached_decode_equals

commands: REXL3_SRC=<engine worktree> ./inkling2mini.sh build <40-hex>   # engine e9eeea9683ed9c897ece83e5eac103bad6e40ee4 (the merge of the integration head e2b8414 and the drafter lane)
SPEC=dspark PREFIX_CACHE=on VISION=on ./inkling2mini.sh start   # EXTRA_ENV empty
python3 bench/tools/gates.py spec A-spec.json --max-tokens 128; gates.py vision A-vision.json --max-tokens 64; cache_images.py --out A-cache-images.json; gates.py cache A-cache.json --max-tokens 128
python3 bench/tools/specedge.py --out A-specedge.json; exactness.py record A-exactness.json --max-tokens 128; exactness.py concurrent --max-tokens 64

SPEC=none PREFIX_CACHE=off VISION=on ... start; gates.py spec B-spec.json --serial-boot; gates.py spec-diff; gates.py vision B-vision.json; gates.py diff; cache_images.py --reference-only; cache_compare.py --images A B; exactness.py diff
SPEC=dspark PREFIX_CACHE=off VISION=on ... start; gates.py vision C-vision.json; gates.py diff C B; cache_images.py --reference-only; cache_compare.py --images C B
notes: Engine e9eeea9 for every server run; the GPU tests ran on the lab tree of the same content (85fb069 adds a changelog fragment only).
